name: Charlotte Linlin
effect:
[On Play] Your opponent chooses one:
• Draw 2 cards.
• Your opponent trashes 2 cards from their hand.
[On Your Opponent's Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Up to 1 of your Leader or Characters gains +1000 power during this battle.

official_faq.question: If my opponent chooses “• Draw 2 cards.” with this [On Play] effect, which player draws the cards?
official_faq.answer: In this case, the player who activated this [On Play] effect draws 2 cards.

official_faq.question: If my opponent chooses “• Your opponent trashes 2 cards from their hand.” with this [On Play] effect, which player chooses the cards to be trashed?
official_faq.answer: The opponent of the player who activated this [On Play] effect chooses 2 cards from their own hand and trashes them.

official_faq.question: If my opponent has 1 or fewer cards in their hand when this [On Play] effect is activated, can they choose “• Your opponent trashes 2 cards from their hand.”?
official_faq.answer: Yes, they can. In this case, if your opponent has 1 card in their hand, they trash that card. If they have 0 cards in their hand, nothing happens.
